canonical_statement: The universe contains a unifying spiritual essence or animating principle known as the Soul of the World.

attributions.surface_quote: appendices on... the Soul of the World

canonical_statement: Celestial bodies are associated with specific spiritual intelligences and divine names.

attributions.surface_quote: planets, their virtues... divine names, intelligences, and spirits

canonical_statement: Mathematical structures can represent and embody the divine order of the universe.

attributions.surface_quote: tables of numbers... represent that divine order

canonical_statement: Specific numerical configurations possess the capacity to influence outcomes toward good or evil.

attributions.surface_quote: numbers... agency to what is good... to what is bad

canonical_statement: Supercelestial intelligences are expressed and manifested through numerical marks and characters.

attributions.surface_quote: supercelestial intelligences... can no other way be expressed, than by marks of numbers

canonical_statement: The Soul of the World acts as the medium through which the Ideas of the Divine Mind are impressed upon celestial entities.

attributions.surface_quote: Ideas of the Divine Mind, by means of the Soul of the World

canonical_statement: Material numbers and figures function only as representations of hidden metaphysical realities, not as the realities themselves.

attributions.surface_quote: material numbers... can do nothing... but representatively

canonical_statement: Matter and spirit are unified and governed by the will of an elevated soul through divine numerations and intelligences.

attributions.surface_quote: unite the extremes of the matter, and spirit to the will

canonical_statement: A universal soul acts as the intermediary through which divine power is applied to material forms.

attributions.surface_quote: power from God, applied through the Soul of the Universe

canonical_statement: Celestial constellations and divine numerations inform and govern the structure of reality.

attributions.surface_quote: governed, and informed by intelligences, and divine numerations

canonical_statement: Celestial bodies possess associated intelligences and spirits that influence terrestrial outcomes.

attributions.surface_quote: an intelligence to good, with a spirit to bad

canonical_statement: Specific geometric and numerical configurations (magic squares) can be used to derive spiritual characters.

attributions.surface_quote: from the square of eight... is drawn a character

canonical_statement: The interaction between planetary alignment (fortune) and material substrates determines the efficacy of a talisman.

attributions.surface_quote: Mars being fortunate, being engraven on an iron plate

canonical_statement: Celestial bodies and their associated numeric squares possess an inherent influence over human destiny and psychological states.

attributions.surface_quote: Sun being fortunate, renders him that wears it to be renowned

canonical_statement: The universe is structured around a correspondence between numeric patterns, divine names, and spiritual intelligences.

attributions.surface_quote: divine names with an intelligency to what is good

canonical_statement: Material objects can be imbued with spiritual properties through the engraving of specific characters and numeric squares.

attributions.surface_quote: engraven on a golden plate... renders him that wears it

canonical_statement: Spiritual entities are categorized by a binary of 'good' intelligencies and 'evil' spirits.

attributions.surface_quote: intelligency to what is good, and spirit to what is evil

canonical_statement: Supernatural entities are categorized by their moral alignment into benevolent intelligences and malevolent spirits.

attributions.surface_quote: intelligence to denote a benevolent... spirit to denote a malevolent

canonical_statement: Celestial bodies exert a variable influence on terrestrial affairs based on their astrological positioning.

attributions.surface_quote: Saturn occupies a favorable position... causing its influence to be benign

canonical_statement: Specific mineral substances possess inherent metaphysical properties capable of altering human psychological states and neutralizing malevolent magic.

attributions.surface_quote: stone corneola... cause concord... render harmless witchcrafts
